name: playwright-cucumber-saucedemo
description: Reto de automatización Front-End bancario utilizando Playwright con Cucumber y TypeScript

scripts.report:generate: npm run report:env && allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report
scripts.test:allure:qa: cross-env AMBIENTE=qa npm-run-all --continue-on-error --sequential test:qa report:generate report:open
scripts.test:allure:dev: cross-env AMBIENTE=dev npm-run-all --continue-on-error --sequential test:dev report:generate report:open
scripts.test:allure:prod: cross-env AMBIENTE=prod npm-run-all --continue-on-error --sequential test:prod report:generate report:open
